title: MiaomiaonV2 Battery Life
symptom: Since switching to Miaomiao V2, the battery life is down to 15% with 4 days left on the sensor, and it may not last the duration.
fix: A user suggests buying a clip on mount that allows charging the unit, and another user found that applying only the double-sided sticker to the rectangular section of the Miaomiao 2 allows removal without disturbing the sensor.
evidence_quote: I bought a clip on mount that works great with no adhesive, allows charging the unit.
